# CORE MDM

> CORE MDM is Android device management run from a web browser. It installs on any Android 8.0+ phone as device owner, then lets the phone's owner lock it down, filter content, block apps and settings, and send commands from a web console at coremdm.org/console, in real time.

CORE MDM is for phones you own or are authorized to manage, used openly. It is not a tool for covert monitoring. Each phone is tied to the account that signed in on it, and only that account can see or manage it.

Key facts:

- Works on any brand (Samsung, Google Pixel, Motorola, Xiaomi and more) running Android 8.0 or newer.
- Installs from the browser over USB (Chrome or Edge), or by scanning a setup QR code on a freshly reset phone. Nothing to download on the computer.
- The phone must be fresh or factory reset, with no accounts signed in, because Android only lets an app become device owner on such a phone.
- As device owner it can block uninstalling, factory reset, safe mode and USB debugging, so the rules stay on.
- Features: remote lock, alarm, reboot, full lockdown and wipe; block app installs, uninstalls and sideloading; hide the Play Store and browsers; disable camera and screenshots; DNS content filter and enforced Private DNS; kiosk mode; lock Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, mobile network and VPN settings; block USB transfer, SD cards and outgoing calls.
- Rules already applied keep working when the phone is offline; new changes arrive as soon as it is back online.
- Organizations (charities, schools, communities, companies) can apply one set of rules to every phone and put their own logo on the lock screen.

- [Features](https://coremdm.org/features): everything CORE MDM can do

- [Organizations](https://coremdm.org/organizations): CORE MDM for groups and companies

- [FAQ](https://coremdm.org/faq): common questions
